verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) at developers.dialpad.com that indexes guides and API reference entries. Markdown versions of doc pages are also served, with an agentTools projectIndex frontmatter pointing back to llms.txt, and a second llms.txt exists on www.dialpad.com covering product and MCP overviews. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at standard paths (all probed paths 404), independent hands-on reports of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developers.dialpad.com/llms.txt # Dialpad Documentation
